title: Duppaññasuttaṃ
text: 225 . Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami…pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘duppañño eḷamūgo, duppañño eḷamūgo’ti , bhante, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccatī’’ti? ‘‘Sattannaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccati. Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ? Satisambojjhaṅgassa…pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa – imesaṃ kho, bhikkhu , sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccatī’’ti. Catutthaṃ.
